events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 move to the brink of a back-to-back FA Premier League title triumph after winning 2–1 at relegation-threatened 입스위치 타운, with 에리크 캉토나 and 라이언 긱스 both scoring the net after Chris Kiwomya gave the hosts an early lead. Down in Division One, Lennie Lawrence resigns as manager of 미들즈브러 after the Ayresome Park side missed out on the playoffs and the chance of an immediate return to the Premier League. Former player 그레임 수네스 is one of the names quickly linked to the 미들즈브러 manager's job, as are the likes of 브라이언 롭슨 , Brian Little , 고든 스트라컨 and 스티브 코펠 .
블랙번 로버스's 2–1 defeat at Coventry gives the Premier League title to 맨체스터 유나이티드 for a second successive season.
아스널 win the European Cup Winners' Cup by beating 파르마 1–0. The only goal in the Final comes from Alan Smith , who has missed most of this season due to injuries.

On the final weekend of the Premier League season, Oldham go in to their final game at 노리치 시티 needing a win to stand any chance of survival, but a 1–1 draw at Carrow Road is not enough to save them and they go down after three seasons in the top flight. Already-relegated Swindon lose 5–0 at home to Leeds, meaning that they become the first top flight team in 30 years to finish a league campaign with 100 goals conceded. 에버턴 perform a miracle escape from relegation by beating 윔블던 3-2 after going two goals down in the first half at Goodison Park . 셰필드 유나이티드 would have stayed up goal difference had they not conceded a last time goal at Stamford Bridge which gave 첼시 3–2 win and enabled 입스위치 타운 to survive by a single point after drawing 0–0 with league runners-up 블랙번 로버스 at Ewood Park . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 secure a UEFA Cup place for the first time in 17 years by finishing third.
The last Premier League game of the season sees 맨체스터 유나이티드 draw 0–0 at home to Coventry and receive the Premier League trophy.

맨체스터 유나이티드 complete the 'double' by beating 첼시 4–0 in the 1994 FA Cup Final . The deadlock had yet to be broken at half time, before 에리크 캉토나 converted two penalties, 마크 휴스 scored United's third goal (his sixth cup final goal in five seasons) and substitute 브라이언 매클레어 completed the scoring just before the final whistle. United's status as league champions means that 첼시 will enter the European Cup Winners' Cup next season, their first venture into European competition for more than 20 years.
맨체스터 유나이티드 wins 4–0 over 첼시 to claim the FA Cup .
브라이언 롭슨 calls time on 13 years and nearly 500 appearances for 맨체스터 유나이티드 to become player-manager of 미들즈브러.
AC 밀란 beat 바르셀로나 4–0, in the Champions League Final to claim their fifth crown .

QPR give a free transfer to 37-year-old midfielder 레이 윌킨스 , the veteran midfielder who played 84 times for England between 1978 and 1986. 미들즈브러 announce the appointment of 브라이언 롭슨 as player-manager, ending the 37-year-old 맨체스터 유나이티드 captain's 13-year spell at 맨체스터 유나이티드.
맷 르티시에, who has been linked with a move to several big clubs including 맨체스터 유나이티드, signs a new contract to stay at 사우샘프턴 until at least 1997.
레이 윌킨스 becomes player-coach of newly promoted 크리스털 팰리스.
뤼트 휠릿 plays his last and 66th international match for the Netherlands national team . Afterwards the striker declares he doesn't want to go to the 1994 FIFA World Cup under coach 딕 아드보카트 .
위컴 원더러스 win the Division Three playoffs at the end of their first season as a Football League club, defeating 프레스턴 노스 엔드 4-2 at Wembley.

번리 beat 스톡포트 카운티 2-1 in the Division Two playoff final, ending their 11-year spell in the lower two tiers of the English league, and condemning Stockport to their fourth Wembley defeat in three seasons.

레스터 시티 beat their East Midlands rivals 더비 카운티 2-1 in the Division One playoff final to end their seven-year absence from the top flight, as well as winning at Wembley for the first time after seven attempts (four FA Cup final defeats and most recently back-to-back playoff final defeats).
아스널 sign Swedish midfielder Stefan Schwarz from 벤피카 for £1.75million.
